senses.gloss: (b. h.; √אם , v. אֵם; cmp. אַמָּה) to arrange in lines, array.
units: Ukts. II, 5 nuts שאֲמָנָן which one arranged (Var. Ar. שחמרן which one piled).—Denom. אוּמָן expert, skilful, whence
<cite ref="Shabbat 103a:3">Sabb. 103ᵃ</cite> <he>מְאַמֵּן את ידו</he> he trains his hand (practicing). V. <cite ref="A02039">next w.</cite>
